note: spring5-security-batch: BatchConfig uses JobBuilderFactory / StepBuilderFactory (removed in Batch 5) and the old Job / Step packages → JobBuilder / StepBuilder with the JobRepository bean — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|Step` (1b37194675) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|Job` (fc480d5c75) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|JobBuilderFactory` (9d52834b21) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|StepBuilderFactory` (381ada2b7a)
response:
<analysis>JobBuilderFactory / StepBuilderFactory were removed in Spring Batch 5: jobs and steps are built with new JobBuilder(name, jobRepository) / new StepBuilder(name, jobRepository), the JobRepository being injected. Batch 6 also moved Job / Step to core.job / core.step. The script relocates the imports, drops the injected factory fields, turns factory.get("x") into new JobBuilder("x", jobRepository) / new StepBuilder("x", jobRepository) and adds a JobRepository jobRepository parameter to every @Bean method that now needs it. tasklet(t) without a transaction manager exists in Batch 6.</analysis>
<script>
import re

# Spring Batch 6 package moves (verified against spring-batch-core / -infrastructure 6.0.4)
MOVES = (
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.Job;", "org.springframework.batch.core.job.Job;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.JobExecution;", "org.springframework.batch.core.job.JobExecution;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.JobParameters;", "org.springframework.batch.core.job.parameters.JobParameters;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.Step;", "org.springframework.batch.core.step.Step;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.StepContribution;", "org.springframework.batch.core.step.StepContribution;"),
    ("org.springframework.batch.core.StepExecution;", "org.springframework.batch.core.step.StepExecution;"),
)
PACKAGES = (("org.springframework.batch.item.", "org.springframework.batch.infrastructure.item."),
            ("org.springframework.batch.repeat.", "org.springframework.batch.infrastructure.repeat."),
            ("org.springframework.batch.support.", "org.springframework.batch.infrastructure.support."))


def relocate(text):
    for old, new in MOVES:
        text = text.replace("import " + old, "import " + new)
    for old, new in PACKAGES:
        text = re.sub(r"(?<![\w.])" + re.escape(old), new, text)
    return text

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen

FIELD = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*@Autowired\s*\n[ \t]*private\s+(Job|Step)BuilderFactory\s+(\w+);[ \t]*\n(?:[ \t]*\n)?", re.M)
FACTORY_IMPORT = re.compile(r"^import\s+org\.springframework\.batch\.core\.configuration\.annotation\."
                            r"(?:Job|Step)BuilderFactory;\n", re.M)
BUILDER_IMPORTS = ("import org.springframework.batch.core.job.builder.JobBuilder;",
                   "import org.springframework.batch.core.repository.JobRepository;",
                   "import org.springframework.batch.core.step.builder.StepBuilder;")
METHOD = re.compile(r"(@Bean\s+public\s+[\w.<>]+\s+\w+\()([^)]*)(\)\s*\{)(.*?)(\n    \})", re.S)


def add_repository(m):
    params, body = m.group(2), m.group(4)
    if "jobRepository" not in body or "JobRepository jobRepository" in params:
        return m.group(0)
    params = "JobRepository jobRepository" + (", " + params if params.strip() else "")
    return m.group(1) + params + m.group(3) + body + m.group(5)


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        text = p.read(path)
        fields = {name: kind for kind, name in FIELD.findall(text)}
        new = relocate(text)
        new = FIELD.sub("", new)
        for name, kind in fields.items():
            new = re.sub(r"\b" + name + r"\.get\(", f"new {kind}Builder(", new)
        new = re.sub(r"new (Job|Step)Builder\(([^()]*)\)", r"new \1Builder(\2, jobRepository)", new)
        new = METHOD.sub(add_repository, new)
        if fields:
            new = FACTORY_IMPORT.sub("", new)
            missing = [i for i in BUILDER_IMPORTS if i not in new]
            if missing:
                new = re.sub(r"^(import org\.springframework\.batch\.[^\n]*\n)", lambda m: m.group(1)
                             + "\n".join(missing) + "\n", new, count=1, flags=re.M)
            if "@Autowired" not in new.replace("import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;", ""):
                new = new.replace("import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;\n", "")
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: Batch 6 builders ({', '.join(sorted(fields)) or 'imports only'})")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: nothing to change")
</script>
